catalog_gate: GET /v1/models → 403 {"code":"INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE","message":"Insufficient account balance"} for every fresh account (balance 0; subsidy campaign paused).
notes: Catalog cannot be enumerated while balance is 0. Group 2 is used for minted keys (minimum_balance_usd 0); once an account is funded the same keys should expose the catalog. Source of group table: GET /api/v1/groups/available (user session), saved raw at out/groups-available.json.
